name: Argent Dawn
summary: Across Azeroth, the Argent Dawn holds its ground against the Scourge and the Burning Legion. Survivors of the Silver Hand formed the order after rejecting the Scarlet Crusade's zealotry. They welcome champions of any race or faction who honor the Light, from Light's Hope Chapel to outposts across Kalimdor.

sections.title: A Schism of Faith
sections.body:
After Highlord Alexandros Mograine fell and Lordaeron collapsed, the Knights of the Silver Hand split over what to do. Grief and paranoia drove many survivors into the xenophobic Scarlet Crusade.

Lord Maxwell Tyrosus and other veterans saw that their former comrades had forsaken the true tenets of the Holy Light. They would neither yield to madness nor abandon the dead kingdom. So they formed the Argent Dawn, ready to defend Azeroth beside any fighter from the Alliance or the Horde.

sections.title: Front Lines of the Plaguelands
sections.body:
Light's Hope Chapel, in the blighted Eastern Plaguelands, is the Argent Dawn's chief stronghold. From there, the order directs its war against Kel'Thuzad's necromancers and skeletal legions. Its forward camps include Chillwind Camp and a camp outside the Bulwark in Tirisfal Glades.

Argent officers give adventurers enchanted commissions and pay bounties for Scourgestones taken from fallen undead. The Dawn has fewer fighters than the Scarlet Crusade, yet perseverance, unity, and discipline keep it holding the line.

sections.title: Vigilance Across Azeroth
sections.body: Lordaeron remains the Argent Dawn's main battleground, but its watch reaches across Kalimdor and the world's capitals. The order keeps diplomatic presences in Stormwind City, Darnassus, and the goblin trade town of Everlook. In Darkshore and Ashenvale, operatives such as Delgren the Purifier contest demonic cults. Scouts in Desolace and the flooded ruins of Blackfathom Deeps investigate threats involving the Shadow Council and the Twilight's Hammer cult.

sections.title: Uneasy Truces and Hidden Foes
sections.body:
The Argent Dawn fights the Scourge while the Brotherhood of the Light, a pragmatic sect, tries to keep a cold truce with the Scarlet Crusade. Relations remain strained. Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff and other high-ranking officers sanction covert strikes against Scarlet leaders in Stratholme. They seek to purge what they see as heretical madness.

The Dawn also faces attempts to infiltrate its ranks. Secret agents siphon necromantic secrets from the front lines for treacherous masters elsewhere.

faq.q: What is the difference between the Argent Dawn and the Scarlet Crusade?
faq.answer: Both orders arose from the Silver Hand's remnants after Lordaeron fell. The Scarlet Crusade became fanatical and xenophobic, seeing outsiders and non-humans as possible carriers of the plague. The Argent Dawn kept to the Holy Light's true tenets and welcomes Alliance and Horde races to fight evil together.

faq.q: What do I do with Scourgestones?
faq.answer: Argent Dawn officers accept Scourgestones as proof of service against the undead. The tokens mark victories over the Scourge and help the order recognize its allies.

faq.q: Can Horde players join or work with the Argent Dawn?
faq.answer: Yes. The Argent Dawn is neutral and stands apart from political allegiances. It welcomes orcs, trolls, tauren, and even Forsaken who fight the Scourge and the Burning Legion. Its recruitment stations include the Bulwark on the Tirisfal border.

faq.q: What are they doing in Kalimdor?
aliases: why is argent dawn in darkshore
faq.answer: The Argent Dawn seeks to protect all Azeroth, not only Lordaeron. Its agents have gone to Darkshore, Ashenvale, and Desolace to fight Shadow Council cults, confront Twilight's Hammer conspirators, and guard against demonic incursions.

faq.q: What is the Brotherhood of the Light?
faq.answer: The Brotherhood of the Light is a militant faction within the Argent Dawn, led by Commander Eligor Dawnbringer. Its members try to keep a working, if tense, relationship with the Scarlet Crusade so both can turn their fury on Kel'Thuzad instead of each other.

angles.text: For holy warriors, the Argent Dawn carries on the Silver Hand's uncorrupted legacy. It holds to compassion, sacrifice, and duty after the Scarlet Crusade gave in to madness.
Though former knights of Lordaeron founded the Argent Dawn, it welcomes Horde champions without prejudice. Its camps give Horde heroes one of the few ways to fight directly in the Plaguelands.
As a Forsaken who despises the Scourge, you can find a rare, practical refuge in the Argent Dawn's camps. Your actions against Kel'Thuzad matter more to the order than your rotting flesh.
The Argent Dawn keeps official embassies in Stormwind and Darnassus. As an Alliance soldier, you can join its fight to reclaim Lordaeron from the Lich King's grasp.
